provenance: A native compatibility implementation requiring an installed copy of Pinball Illusions: the package holds only its own code, and the game's data comes from your GOG release each time it runs.

latest.note: The first release: the intro, the table chooser with its Info pages, and all four tables play with music and sound; high scores are kept. It needs your installed GOG release.

brings.title: Starts with a double click
brings.text: No installer, no command line, nothing else to install. On the first start it finds your GOG release by itself and copies the game's files, with the CD's music.

brings.title: The intro, the chooser and all four tables
brings.text: The intro, the table chooser with its Info pages, and Law 'n Justice, Babewatch, Extreme Sports and The Vikings, with music and sound. High scores are kept.

brings.title: A setup screen before the game
brings.text: Start the game as it starts or one of the four tables at once, skip the intro, and set the game's options, the sound, the keys and a controller's buttons.

brings.title: Fixes for the original's bugs
brings.text: Holes play their own sound, initials stay in the high scores, and the shooting game awards its 25-hit extra ball. Each fix is on by default and can be switched off.

brings.title: Flippers, plunger and nudges
brings.text: Shift or Ctrl for the flippers, Enter launches the ball, Space and Alt nudge; every key can be changed on the setup screen, and a controller works too.

brings.title: Your things stay yours
brings.text: Settings, saves and high scores live in your user folder: a new version replaces the program's folder and keeps them. It looks for new versions only if you say yes, and installs one only after you confirm.
